basis: Curtiss-Wright’s May 4, 2022 release establishes that Q1 2022 consolidated GAAP net sales were $559,461,000, down 6.30% from $597,059,000 in Q1 2021 and below the $567,206,050 threshold. The earliest disclosure date remains unverified because the substantive remarks from management’s March 17 investor webcast were unavailable. The comparison type and upper bound below describe the verified actual result.

coverage.detail: November 3, 2021, preceding earnings cycle. The Q3 release addressed the remainder of 2021 and updated FY2021 adjusted EPS guidance. It supplied no Q1 2022 consolidated sales ceiling.
November 4 Q3 call slides. The 7%–9% total sales growth range applied to FY2021 versus FY2020.
February 23, 2022, immediately preceding earnings release. The $2.530 billion–$2.580 billion sales outlook covered all of FY2022. It supplied no allocation that bounded Q1 sales.

February 24 Q4 call, slide 7. Management expected Q1 2022 EPS below its prior-year level. The sales range on that slide was annual. Available call excerpts also discuss sales shifting from the first half to the second half, which leaves the Q1 amount undetermined.
March 2 Form 8-K exhibit. The preliminary announcement concerned the proxy statement and Saddle Point’s director nominations. It contained no preliminary Q1 sales figure.
March 9 Form 8-K exhibit. The company announced a resolution with Saddle Point and supplied no Q1 sales range.

March 15 issuer notice scheduled a public CEO and CFO fireside chat for March 17 at 12:30 p.m. ET, with no formal presentation and a replay offered for approximately 30 days. I could verify the event but could not retrieve an issuer replay or full public transcript to check the Q&A for a Q1 sales ceiling.

The March 17 transcript preview confirms the event occurred. The issuer’s investor-relations officer specifically mentions the Q1 2022 outlook in the opening safe-harbor statement. Public access ends before the substantive discussion.

The issuer archive lists a March 24 technical announcement, an April 7 Q1 earnings scheduling notice, and April 20 and May 3 contract announcements before the May 4 results. No preliminary earnings release appears in that interval.

May 4 actuals. The consolidated earnings table gives total net sales in thousands of 559,461 and 597,059 for the three months ended March 31, 2022 and 2021. The reconciliation removes $7,102,000 from prior-year reported sales to reach adjusted sales of $589,957,000, including an adjustment for the German valves business sold in January 2022. The reported comparison retains the full $597,059,000 base.
Item 2.02 expressly records that Curtiss-Wright issued the Q1 earnings release on Wednesday, May 4, and scheduled the results call for Thursday, May 5.

publication_date_evidence: Both the issuer’s release dateline and Item 2.02 of its Form 8-K establish May 4, 2022 as the public release date for actuals. The unresolved March 17 management remarks prevent verification that May 4 was the first qualifying communication.
